description: The learning enters through its ONLY door and the honesty is on full display: provenance is REQUIRED on the wire (the column has no default at the database) and here it is `observed`, so `observedCount` rides beside it — M3's strength, set once at write time, the count is the strength. The agent scope is validated by a Go-level check (design §3), so `scopeKey` names a real agent, and `provenance` is `observed`, never `relaxed` (M1: relayed is refused at this door — a hand-authored board answer makes the label lie about its own source). The tags travel with the write (M5).

params.body: nil-map writes panic — checked once, remembered forever
